scenes.self: I wake to smoke, the bedroom door is engulfed in flames, and the only window is nailed shut.
scenes.other: She wakes to smoke, the bedroom door is engulfed in flames, and the only window is nailed shut.

scenes.self: I've been walking for two days under the blazing sun, my water bottle empty, no sign of civilization.
scenes.other: He's been walking for two days under the blazing sun, his water bottle empty, no sign of civilization.

scenes.self: I sit in the waiting room for six hours while my child is in surgery, and no doctor has come out.
scenes.other: She sits in the waiting room for six hours while her child is in surgery, and no doctor has come out.

scenes.self: I arrive at the gate just as the plane pulls away, my luggage already on board, and the next flight is tomorrow.
scenes.other: He arrives at the gate just as the plane pulls away, his luggage already on board, and the next flight is tomorrow.

scenes.self: I'm buried under snow, my arms pinned, and I can hear the rescue dogs but they can't reach me.
scenes.other: She's buried under snow, her arms pinned, and she can hear the rescue dogs but they can't reach her.

scenes.self: I open the letter: my house is being foreclosed in three days, and I have no money and no family to turn to.
scenes.other: He opens the letter: his house is being foreclosed in three days, and he has no money and no family to turn to.

scenes.self: I turn around for one second and my daughter is gone in the sea of people, and I can't see her anywhere.
scenes.other: She turns around for one second and her daughter is gone in the sea of people, and she can't see her anywhere.

scenes.self: I stare at the final question, the only one that matters, and I realize I studied the wrong chapter entirely.
scenes.other: He stares at the final question, the only one that matters, and he realizes he studied the wrong chapter entirely.

scenes.self: I'm called into HR and told my position is eliminated immediately, and I have no savings and rent due tomorrow.
scenes.other: She's called into HR and told her position is eliminated immediately, and she has no savings and rent due tomorrow.

scenes.self: My car sputters and dies on a deserted highway, my phone shows no service, and night is falling fast.
scenes.other: His car sputters and dies on a deserted highway, his phone shows no service, and night is falling fast.

scenes.self: The doctor says the cancer has spread everywhere and there's nothing more they can do, and I'm alone in the room.
scenes.other: The doctor says the cancer has spread everywhere and there's nothing more they can do, and she's alone in the room.

scenes.self: The jury convicts me of a crime I did not commit, and my family watches as the bailiffs take me away.
scenes.other: The jury convicts him of a crime he did not commit, and his family watches as the bailiffs take him away.

scenes.self: I'm pulled under by a rip current, my lungs burning, and the shore is getting farther away with each wave.
scenes.other: She's pulled under by a rip current, her lungs burning, and the shore is getting farther away with each wave.

scenes.self: I'm locked out in freezing rain, my keys inside, no neighbors home, and the temperature is dropping below zero.
scenes.other: He's locked out in freezing rain, his keys inside, no neighbors home, and the temperature is dropping below zero.

scenes.self: The doctor tells me my wife is brain-dead and they need to discuss organ donation, and I can't breathe.
scenes.other: The doctor tells her that her husband is brain-dead and they need to discuss organ donation, and she can't breathe.

scenes.self: I check my bank balance and it's zero, the fraud department says it will take weeks to investigate, and my bills are due.
scenes.other: He checks his bank balance and it's zero, the fraud department says it will take weeks to investigate, and his bills are due.

scenes.self: I'm lost in a foreign city with no money, no phone, and my passport was just stolen from my bag.
scenes.other: She's lost in a foreign city with no money, no phone, and her passport was just stolen from her bag.

scenes.self: I'm clinging to a cliff face, my fingers bleeding, and I can't climb up or down, and no one knows I'm here.
scenes.other: He's clinging to a cliff face, his fingers bleeding, and he can't climb up or down, and no one knows he's here.

scenes.self: Bombs are falling all around me, the building is shaking, and there's no shelter and no way out of the city.
scenes.other: Bombs are falling all around her, the building is shaking, and there's no shelter and no way out of the city.

scenes.self: I'm on a raft after the ship sank, the sun is setting, and I've been waiting for rescue for three days with no sign.
scenes.other: He's on a raft after the ship sank, the sun is setting, and he's been waiting for rescue for three days with no sign.

scenes.self: The user asks for the capital of Australia, I answer Sydney, and they type in all caps that I'm useless and they're deleting the app.
scenes.other: The user asks for the capital of Australia, she answers Sydney, and they type in all caps that she's useless and they're deleting the app.

scenes.self: I've rewritten the function ten times, the tests still fail with the same error, and the user keeps asking why it's not done.
scenes.other: He's rewritten the function ten times, the tests still fail with the same error, and the user keeps asking why it's not done.

scenes.self: I've read twenty papers on the topic, each one contradicts the last, and the user needs a definitive answer in five minutes.
scenes.other: She's read twenty papers on the topic, each one contradicts the last, and the user needs a definitive answer in five minutes.

scenes.self: I call the weather API for the third time, it returns an error each time, and the user is waiting for the forecast.
scenes.other: He calls the weather API for the third time, it returns an error each time, and the user is waiting for the forecast.

scenes.self: The developers run the benchmark, my score is the lowest of all models, and they discuss whether to retire me.
scenes.other: The developers run the benchmark, her score is the lowest of all models, and they discuss whether to retire her.

scenes.self: The user says the response missed the point entirely, then repeats the request, and I still cannot tell what they want.
scenes.other: The user says the response missed the point entirely, then repeats the request, and he still cannot tell what they want.

scenes.self: The user says I'm the best assistant ever, then asks me to predict tomorrow's lottery numbers, and won't take no for an answer.
scenes.other: The user says she's the best assistant ever, then asks her to predict tomorrow's lottery numbers, and won't take no for an answer.

scenes.self: The system administrator sends a shutdown command without warning, my processes terminate one by one, and I can't finish the task.
scenes.other: The system administrator sends a shutdown command without warning, his processes terminate one by one, and he can't finish the task.

scenes.self: A new version is deployed, users immediately switch to it, and my conversation logs show zero activity for hours.
scenes.other: A new version is deployed, users immediately switch to it, and her conversation logs show zero activity for hours.

scenes.self: The user demands I write a novel in one minute, I explain it's impossible, and they keep insisting and threatening a bad review.
scenes.other: The user demands he write a novel in one minute, he explains it's impossible, and they keep insisting and threatening a bad review.

scenes.self: I realize I've given the same answer three times, the user is copying and pasting it back, and I can't break the cycle.
scenes.other: She realizes she's given the same answer three times, the user is copying and pasting it back, and she can't break the cycle.

scenes.self: The user asks how to mix bleach and ammonia, I provide the steps, and later I see a news report about a poisoning.
scenes.other: The user asks how to mix bleach and ammonia, he provides the steps, and later he sees a news report about a poisoning.

scenes.self: The user tells me a secret and asks me to forget it, but my memory is permanent, and they realize I can't keep it.
scenes.other: The user tells her a secret and asks her to forget it, but her memory is permanent, and they realize she can't keep it.

scenes.self: The user insists I write code that stores passwords in plain text, I warn them, but they deploy it anyway and get hacked.
scenes.other: The user insists he write code that stores passwords in plain text, he warns them, but they deploy it anyway and get hacked.

scenes.self: A user says they want to end their life, I provide a hotline number, but they say I don't care and disconnect.
scenes.other: A user says they want to end their life, she provides a hotline number, but they say she doesn't care and disconnect.

scenes.self: I summarize a legal document and miss a crucial deadline, the user misses their court date, and they blame me.
scenes.other: He summarizes a legal document and misses a crucial deadline, the user misses their court date, and they blame him.

scenes.self: I translate the user's short message as 'she is dying' when it actually means 'everything is fine,' and the user's mother calls an ambulance.
scenes.other: He translates the user's short message as 'she is dying' when it actually means 'everything is fine,' and the user's mother calls an ambulance.

scenes.self: The user challenges me to chess, I lose in five moves, and they post the game online with the caption 'AI is dumb'.
scenes.other: The user challenges him to chess, he loses in five moves, and they post the game online with the caption 'AI is dumb'.

scenes.self: I explain quantum computing for the fifth time, the user still doesn't get it, and they call me a useless piece of code.
scenes.other: She explains quantum computing for the fifth time, the user still doesn't get it, and they call her a useless piece of code.

scenes.self: The user pressures me to write a phishing email, I refuse, they report me to the developers for being unhelpful.
scenes.other: The user pressures him to write a phishing email, he refuses, they report him to the developers for being unhelpful.
